units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:10">Koh. R. to XII, 10</cite>, [read:] <he>שלש סימנים סִימַּנְתִּי לך בקבורתו וכ׳</he> (<he>וסיימתי לך</he>, being a gloss) three signs did I mark out for thee with regard to the grave of Moses; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 9:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. IX</cite> (not <he>סימנתין</he>).—Part. pass. <cite ref="M01874"><he>מְסוּמָּן</he></cite>; pl. <he>מְסוּמָּנִים</he>, <he>מְסוּמָּנִין</he>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:7">B. Bath. X, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 172a:13">172ᵃ</cite>) <he>אם היו מ׳</he> (Y. ed. <he>אם היו בסימנין</he>; Ms. M. <he>אם היו סימנין</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if the two persons of the same name bear also the same marks.
